name: Donald Trump
ideology: America First — populist, protectionist trade policy, reduced multilateral commitment emphasis
period_active: 47th President, second non-consecutive term, inaugurated 20 January 2025 (also 45th President, 2017-2021); Vice President is J.D. Vance
foreign_policy_position: Transactional bilateralism, tariff-driven trade pressure, scepticism of open-ended multilateral commitments, continued strategic competition with China.
current_status: In office; second-term approval ratings had declined through 2025-2026 per multiple published polling; 2026 midterm elections scheduled for 3 November 2026.
